name: Datadog
whyPeoplePay: Datadog sells observability as a product surface: hosts, APM, logs and dashboards on one bill that grows with infrastructure, so a team never wires Prometheus alone at 2am. Host-based infrastructure pricing is the tax on not running your own stack.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Infrastructure monitoring is quoted per host per month; $15 is a common list starting point for Pro host metrics. Confirm current list price; real bills are modular and often negotiated.

pricing.note: Datadog pricing is modular (infra, APM, logs) and often negotiated. The Pro figure is a rough per-host infrastructure list anchor from public materials, not a promise of your invoice. Self-hosting Netdata replaces only a thin slice of the suite (host metrics and local dashboards), not full APM and log everything.

ranked.rationale: Per-second host metrics without a per-host SaaS seat. Honest about scope: one agent, deep system charts, closed-source UI under NCUL1, not full APM and log everything Datadog sells.

evaluatedNotTested.name: Grafana + Prometheus
evaluatedNotTested.note: The standard open stack; more pieces than Netdata's single agent. Grafana is already in this catalogue.
